card.name: Partway through longer English words
card.fires_on: Responds to the first piece of a longer English word or compound, such as 'eul' in eulogize, 'agn' in diagnosing, or 'struct' in instruct. Also fires on noun heads like 'Plan', 'Description' and 'history' in set phrases.

modes.label: Inside split words
modes.description: A word is cut into pieces and the marked piece is an early or middle part of it.

modes.label: Document or record nouns
modes.description: A noun naming a document or credential, such as plan, description, diploma or history, ends a short phrase.
modes.example: Job<< Description>>: To Explore the Unknown Curiosity

card.writes: It leans toward document-copy words like copy, original and holder, with little effect on the other suppressed tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the early part of a long word that is split up, and on nouns like plan or description that name a document.
